frequency_question: How often do announced steep bilateral tariffs actually take effect on or before the threatened deadline rather than being withdrawn, delayed, or negotiated away?
membership_rule: Includes direct executive or legislative announcements of steep tariffs on a specific major neighbor/partner nation with a stated implementation window under 90 days. Excludes multilateral broad-based WTO tariff actions or long-phased legislative packages.

cases.name: US-China Section 301 Tariff Threats and Implementation Cycles (2018-2019)
US Threat of Tariffs on Mexican Goods over Border Security (2019)
US Steel and Aluminum Tariffs on Canada and Mexico (2018)

coverage_note: 3 named; representative of high-level bilateral trade brinkmanship
known_gaps: Does not capture informal or backchannel threats that never reached public executive declarations with strict deadlines.
skeleton: Three distinct episodes of high-stakes bilateral tariff threats yielding two implementations and one negotiated withdrawal
validity_reason: Valid through the current political administration's term and standard trade negotiation frameworks.
